verses.ar: لَا تَفْتَخِرْ بِٱلْغَدِ لِأَنَّكَ لَا تَعْلَمُ مَاذَا يَلِدُهُ يَوْمٌ.
verses.kjv: Boast not thyself of to morrow; for thou knowest not what a day may bring forth.
verses.web: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.

verses.ar: لِيَمْدَحْكَ ٱلْغَرِيبُ لَا فَمُكَ، ٱلْأَجْنَبِيُّ لَا شَفَتَاكَ.
verses.kjv: Let another man praise thee, and not thine own mouth; a stranger, and not thine own lips.
verses.web: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

verses.ar: اَلْحَجَرُ ثَقِيلٌ وَٱلرَّمْلُ ثَقِيلٌ، وَغَضَبُ ٱلْجَاهِلِ أَثْقَلُ مِنْهُمَا كِلَيْهِمَا.
verses.kjv: A stone [is] heavy, and the sand weighty; but a fool’s wrath [is] heavier than them both.
verses.web: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

verses.ar: اَلْغَضَبُ قَسَاوَةٌ وَٱلسَّخَطُ جُرَافٌ، وَمَنْ يَقِفُ قُدَّامَ ٱلْحَسَدِ؟
verses.kjv: Wrath [is] cruel, and anger [is] outrageous; but who [is] able to stand before envy?
verses.web: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?

verses.ar: اَلتَّوْبِيخُ ٱلظَّاهِرُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلْحُبِّ ٱلْمُسْتَتِرِ.
verses.kjv: Open rebuke [is] better than secret love.
verses.web: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

verses.ar: أَمِينَةٌ هِيَ جُرُوحُ ٱلْمُحِبِّ، وَغَاشَّةٌ هِيَ قُبْلَاتُ ٱلْعَدُوِّ.
verses.kjv: Faithful [are] the wounds of a friend; but the kisses of an enemy [are] deceitful.
verses.web: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

verses.ar: اَلنَّفْسُ ٱلشَّبْعَانَةُ تَدُوسُ ٱلْعَسَلَ، وَلِلنَّفْسِ ٱلْجَائِعَةِ كُلُّ مُرٍّ حُلْوٌ.
verses.kjv: The full soul loatheth an honeycomb; but to the hungry soul every bitter thing is sweet.
verses.web: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

verses.ar: مِثْلُ ٱلْعُصْفُورِ ٱلتَّائِهِ مِنْ عُشِّهِ، هَكَذَا ٱلرَّجُلُ ٱلتَّائِهُ مِنْ مَكَانِهِ.
verses.kjv: As a bird that wandereth from her nest, so [is] a man that wandereth from his place.
verses.web: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.

verses.ar: اَلدُّهْنُ وَٱلْبَخُورُ يُفَرِّحَانِ ٱلْقَلْبَ، وَحَلَاوَةُ ٱلصَّدِيقِ مِنْ مَشُورَةِ ٱلنَّفْسِ.
verses.kjv: Ointment and perfume rejoice the heart: so [doth] the sweetness of a man’s friend by hearty counsel.
verses.web: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

verses.ar: لَا تَتْرُكْ صَدِيقَكَ وَصَدِيقَ أَبِيكَ، وَلَا تَدْخُلْ بَيْتَ أَخِيكَ فِي يَوْمِ بَلِيَّتِكَ. ٱلْجَارُ ٱلْقَرِيبُ خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلْأَخِ ٱلْبَعِيدِ.
verses.kjv: Thine own friend, and thy father’s friend, forsake not; neither go into thy brother’s house in the day of thy calamity: [for] better [is] a neighbour [that is] near than a brother far off.
verses.web: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، كُنْ حَكِيمًا وَفَرِّحْ قَلْبِي، فَأُجِيبَ مَنْ يُعَيِّرُنِي كَلِمَةً.
verses.kjv: My son, be wise, and make my heart glad, that I may answer him that reproacheth me.
verses.web: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.

verses.ar: ٱلذَّكِيُّ يُبْصِرُ ٱلشَّرَّ فَيَتَوَارَى. ٱلْأَغْبِيَاءُ يَعْبُرُونَ فَيُعَاقَبُونَ.
verses.kjv: A prudent [man] foreseeth the evil, [and] hideth himself; [but] the simple pass on, [and] are punished.
verses.web: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

verses.ar: خُذْ ثَوْبَهُ لِأَنَّهُ ضَمِنَ غَرِيبًا، وَلِأَجْلِ ٱلْأَجَانِبِ ٱرْتَهِنَ مِنْهُ.
verses.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger, and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
verses.web: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!

verses.ar: مَنْ يُبَارِكُ قَرِيبَهُ بِصَوْتٍ عَالٍ فِي ٱلصَّبَاحِ بَاكِرًا، يُحْسَبُ لَهُ لَعْنًا.
verses.kjv: He that blesseth his friend with a loud voice, rising early in the morning, it shall be counted a curse to him.
verses.web: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.

verses.ar: اَلْوَكْفُ ٱلْمُتَتَابِعُ فِي يَوْمٍ مُمْطِرٍ، وَٱلْمَرْأَةُ ٱلْمُخَاصِمَةُ سِيَّانِ،
verses.kjv: A continual dropping in a very rainy day and a contentious woman are alike.
verses.web: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:

verses.ar: مَنْ يُخَبِّئُهَا يُخَبِّئُ ٱلرِّيحَ وَيَمِينُهُ تَقْبِضُ عَلَى زَيْتٍ!
verses.kjv: Whosoever hideth her hideth the wind, and the ointment of his right hand, [which] bewrayeth [itself].
verses.web: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَدِيدُ بِٱلْحَدِيدِ يُحَدَّدُ، وَٱلْإِنْسَانُ يُحَدِّدُ وَجْهَ صَاحِبِهِ.
verses.kjv: Iron sharpeneth iron; so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
verses.web: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

verses.ar: مَنْ يَحْمِي تِينَةً يَأْكُلُ ثَمَرَتَهَا، وَحَافِظُ سَيِّدِهِ يُكْرَمُ.
verses.kjv: Whoso keepeth the fig tree shall eat the fruit thereof: so he that waiteth on his master shall be honoured.
verses.web: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.

verses.ar: كَمَا فِي ٱلْمَاءِ ٱلْوَجْهُ لِلْوَجْهِ، كَذَلِكَ قَلْبُ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ لِلْإِنْسَانِ.
verses.kjv: As in water face [answereth] to face, so the heart of man to man.
verses.web: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.

verses.ar: اَلْهَاوِيَةُ وَٱلْهَلَاكُ لَا يَشْبَعَانِ، وَكَذَا عَيْنَا ٱلْإِنْسَانِ لَا تَشْبَعَانِ.
verses.kjv: Hell and destruction are never full; so the eyes of man are never satisfied.
verses.web: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.

verses.ar: اَلْبُوطَةُ لِلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلْكُورُ لِلذَّهَبِ، كَذَا ٱلْإِنْسَانُ لِفَمِ مَادِحِهِ.
verses.kjv: [As] the fining pot for silver, and the furnace for gold; so [is] a man to his praise.
verses.web: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.

verses.ar: إِنْ دَقَقْتَ ٱلْأَحْمَقَ فِي هَاوُنٍ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّمِيذِ بِمِدَقٍّ، لَا تَبْرَحُ عَنْهُ حَمَاقَتُهُ.
verses.kjv: Though thou shouldest bray a fool in a mortar among wheat with a pestle, [yet] will not his foolishness depart from him.
verses.web: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.

verses.ar: مَعْرِفَةً ٱعْرِفْ حَالَ غَنَمِكَ، وَٱجْعَلْ قَلْبَكَ إِلَى قُطْعَانِكَ،
verses.kjv: Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks, [and] look well to thy herds.
verses.web: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْغِنَى لَيْسَ بِدَائِمٍ، وَلَا ٱلتَّاجُ لِدَوْرٍ فَدَوْرٍ.
verses.kjv: For riches [are] not for ever: and doth the crown [endure] to every generation?
verses.web: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.

verses.ar: فَنِيَ ٱلْحَشِيشُ وَظَهَرَ ٱلْعُشْبُ وَٱجْتَمَعَ نَبَاتُ ٱلْجِبَالِ.
verses.kjv: The hay appeareth, and the tender grass sheweth itself, and herbs of the mountains are gathered.
verses.web: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.

verses.ar: ٱلْحُمْلَانُ لِلِبَاسِكَ، وَثَمَنُ حَقْلٍ أَعْتِدَةٌ.
verses.kjv: The lambs [are] for thy clothing, and the goats [are] the price of the field.
verses.web: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.

verses.ar: وَكِفَايَةٌ مِنْ لَبَنِ ٱلْمَعْزِ لِطَعَامِكَ، لِقُوتِ بَيْتِكَ وَمَعِيشَةِ فَتَيَاتِكَ.
verses.kjv: And [thou shalt have] goats’ milk enough for thy food, for the food of thy household, and [for] the maintenance for thy maidens.
verses.web: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.
